findings.title: Gaza winter - WFP, IOM: tented displacement camps now receive hot meals every other day
findings.publisher: United Nations Office at Geneva (WFP Country Director Shaun Hughes)
findings.location: Tented displacement camps, Gaza Strip; individual sites not identified
findings.affected_population_or_system: WFP-supported displaced families in tented camps; hot-meal frequency. Number of beneficiaries experiencing this frequency is not given.
findings.exact_supporting_passage: Now it's one hot meal every two days.
findings.source_type: Primary humanitarian operational testimony at UN Geneva press briefing; UN audiovisual story and attributed speaker quotation

bounded_discovery_context.discovery_method: One of 12 supplemental targeted searches led to United Nations in Palestine November 18 report and primary United Nations Geneva November 17 press briefing and WFP/IOM news footage transcript.
bounded_discovery_context.material_increment: WFP Palestine country director explicitly described hot-meal service at tented displacement camps changing from daily to every other day. The October 19 overall WFP assistance cuts were already known; the camp-level meal delivery frequency is a previously unrecorded operational detail, not a claim of a new cut this hour.
bounded_discovery_context.caveats: The source does not quantify affected camps, people or the date the reduced frequency started; may be part of pre-existing October WFP cuts, not independently a new policy change.
bounded_discovery_context.duplicate_audit: Compared all November 17–18 ops/watch-ledger Gaza finding titles/identifiers and previous heartbeat exclusions; no earlier watch finding recorded this camp-level frequency.

findings.title: IOM details Gaza tent-entry screening restriction on central pole diameter
findings.publisher: United Nations Office at Geneva (IOM Gaza programme head Karl Baker)
findings.location: Gaza Strip entry procedures; more than 100,000 tents staged outside Gaza, including supplies awaiting dispatch from Egypt
findings.affected_population_or_system: Displaced families requiring durable winter shelter and IOM/humanitarian tents subject to Israeli import clearance; quantity rejected specifically for pole size not reported.
findings.exact_supporting_passage: Usually anything under 38 millimetres is okay; anything above, it’s usually deemed as not acceptable.
findings.source_type: Primary IOM operational testimony at United Nations Geneva press briefing and UN-authored video transcript

bounded_discovery_context.discovery_method: Found in United Nations November 18 field report during bounded search and verified against primary November 17 UN Geneva news-footage shotlist, with an explicit attributed statement from IOM's Gaza head.
bounded_discovery_context.material_increment: IOM specified a concrete central-pole diameter threshold (38 mm) in clearance of tents entering Gaza, clarifying a specific operational impediment to winter shelter access not recorded by earlier watches.
bounded_discovery_context.caveats: More than 100,000 tents awaiting delivery is a separate overall inventory figure; the testimony does not establish how many were rejected under the 38 mm rule, whether a categorical legal prohibition applies, or any new policy adoption date.
bounded_discovery_context.duplicate_audit: November 17–18 Gaza watch finding ledger reviewed; past OCHA/IOM descriptions of general shelter restrictions do not provide this specific clearance threshold.
